loading.description: Loading spinner message while fetching the wishlist

subtitle_one.description: Subtitle under the Wishlist title when there is exactly one book (plural form). Not every locale has every CLDR plural category.

subtitle_other.description: Subtitle under the Wishlist title for other counts (plural form): how many books the user wants to buy

subtitleEmpty.description: Subtitle under the Wishlist title when the wishlist is empty

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Wishlist search field; it matches title and author

searchA11y.description: Spoken label of the Wishlist search field

searchClearA11y.description: Spoken label of the clear (x) button inside the Wishlist search field

emptySearch.title.description: Shown when the search matches no wishlist book. Keep the quotes around the query.

emptySearch.clear.description: Button that clears the Wishlist search

emptyState.title.description: Title of the empty Wishlist state

emptyState.body.description: Body of the empty Wishlist state: scan a shelf or search by title; picked books land here until bought

emptyState.scan.description: Primary button of the empty Wishlist state; opens Scan

emptyState.search.description: Text button of the empty Wishlist state; opens Scan in title search mode

errorLoadWishlist.description: Error message when the wishlist fails to load

errorUpdateStatus.description: Error message when updating a book status fails

errorRemoveBook.description: Error message when removing a book fails

bought.description: Label of the tonal chip on a wishlist row that moves the book to purchased

boughtA11y.description: Accessibility label of the Bought chip, includes the book title

rowA11y.description: Accessibility label of a wishlist row: title, translated status, then the author

rowUnverifiedA11y.description: Accessibility label of the wishlist row of an unverified book (one the user added themselves, #616): title, translated status, author, then that it is unverified

rowHint.description: Accessibility hint of a wishlist row: tapping opens details, where the book can be removed
